title: MSFS 2024 marketplace drop: iniBuilds Luton, Drzewiecki Design & massive night overhauls!
description:
If you're looking to upgrade both your flight destinations and nighttime scenery underneath your wings, the Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 marketplace just dropped a massive lineup. This week delivers heavy-hitter airport releases from iniBuilds and Drzewiecki Design alongside a world-spanning wave of dark-hour visual overhauls across four continents.

In this comprehensive scenery breakdown, we inspect all the new commercial hubs, handcrafted natural landmarks, and regional night lighting packs to help you decide what's claiming top priority in your hangar:

✈️ FLAGSHIP COMMERCIAL & REGIONAL GATEWAYS
We kick off in the UK at London Luton Airport (EGGW) by iniBuilds, featuring high-fidelity terminal and tower interiors, custom EasyJet apron life, and routes to over 160 destinations. Next, we fly stateside to Mobile International Airport (KBFM) by Drzewiecki Design—home to the Airbus US final assembly line—boasting frame-rate friendly terminal interiors and enhanced coastal surroundings. We also visit Szczecin-Goleniów Airport (EPRZ) in Poland to explore Drzewiecki's recreation of both the active airfield and the planned 2027 terminal expansion, before heading to Moulay Ali Cherif Airport (GMFK) in Errachidia, southeastern Morocco by ISMABERK.

🌍 HANDCRAFTED LANDMARKS & NATURAL WONDERS
Shifting to VFR and scenic flying, we explore the natural wonder of Victoria Falls, rebuilt with custom animated 4K rapids, waterfalls, and corrected river elevation mesh. Then we head to Arizona for IronSim’s Tucson City Landmarks, adding over 150+ custom civic buildings, educational facilities, sports venues, and updated night lighting.

🌃 GLOBAL CITY NIGHT ENHANCEMENTS (DREAM SCENERY)
Finally, we break down Dream Scenery’s massive series of night lighting and enhanced road illumination packages designed to transform redeye approaches across North America (Toronto, Washington, San Diego, Bakersfield), Europe (Rotterdam, Rome, Santander, Murcia, Lille-Roubaix, Moscow), and Asia/Australia (Sydney, Seoul, Beijing, Bangkok, Osaka-Kobe-Kyoto, Antalya).

Which of these new airports or scenery packages is landing on your SSD first? Are you flying airliner turns out of Luton, testing Airbus ops at Mobile, or doing night approaches into Rome and Sydney? Let us know in the comments below!

If this marketplace guide helped you navigate the latest MSFS 2024 additions, remember to hit that like button, subscribe to the channel, and blue skies on your next flight!
